close_reason: Superseded by JMAP-7a8b.7 (same issue, more precise suggested fix)
description: The CRLF validation in handle_mdn_send (step 4) uses 10 consecutive 'if \!crlf_bad { ... }' blocks. Each block independently checks one optional field. The pattern is O(n_fields) even if a bad field is found early, because the checks fall through (actually they do short-circuit due to the if \!crlf_bad guard, so this is not a real efficiency issue). The issue is readability more than efficiency — the 10-block pattern duplicates the same structure 10 times. At scale (if more fields are added) this grows linearly and is easy to miss. Expected impact at scale: minimal (fields are bounded by spec), but the structural problem remains.
title: CRLF validation in handle_mdn_send uses 10 if-else blocks instead of iterator short-circuit
